reviews.title: Best budget motherboard
reviews.comment: Best budget motherboard. I have it paired with a 13400f and since I've owned it, I have not had any problems with it! Stability: So far, I've tried ram at 6400Mhz, and its been running very stable and fast with no crashes or problems with my applications. Aesthetics: Great looking matx mobo. you can turn off the rgb if you want a non-rgb build, or you can have it turned on. Even when turned on, the RGB is very subtle which I think its a nice touch as I don't like components that are too flashy. Performance: Performance is great if you aren't OCing. I have this same mobo paired with a 12400f and was able to oc th BCLK, so if you have a 12th gen chip, you can at least OC the BCLK, but for 13th gen you are not able to do that. Either way, the performance is great, and my cpu runs VERY cool while also clocking to max frequency when needed. Overall thoughts: For the price, this mobo is great. One of the best MOBO's I've ever used tbh and I was pleasantly surprised at how well it performed. I usually stick to Asus, but decided to try Asrock out since I've heard good things about them and their prices are great. I'm now a fan of Asrock. If you're looking for a good mobo at a good price, get this mobo. You will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: James Franks

reviews.title: A lot of USB Ports with Wifi included!
reviews.comment: I like this motherboard better than the B760M RS Pro...  It has more USB's in the rear panel and Having the Wifi card and antenna's already setup is great.  It just lacks the 3rd M2 slot,  But 2 M2 NvME slots are enough.  Bios is easy to deal with and the fan tuning is great.  The board runs cool too because of the heat sinks on the CPU VRM chips.  Running a i5-12600kf just fine.
reviews.author: tmanners

reviews.title: Excellent budget board
reviews.comment: Fantastic motherboard for the price point. The VRM design and heatsinks beat out any other mATX motherboard in this price range. Paired with a 14400F, have had no issues, BIOS was updated for 14th generation support out of the box.
reviews.author: R

reviews.title: Good board at an affordable price
reviews.comment: Everything fit nicely, WIFI is fast and easy to set up! I wish the M.2 slots we're easier to access and had a better heatsink. The CPU Power port on this has come off already though. I was able to glue it back on, but something to look out for. Plenty of USB ports and the board looks nice through a glass window.
